data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 巫女罗裳半褪的仰卧心意
data.description: 神社静谧内殿的和室草席上，朱乃侧卧在铺展开的绯红绒毡上。纯白巫女上衣松解散开，展现出丰润白皙的肩颈与锁骨。浓密的黑色单马尾如墨色锦缎铺在红毡旁，单手轻托微热的面颊，眼角的泪痣与迷离紫眸相映，在摇曳的和风纸灯暖光下轻诉脉脉深情。
data.location: 神社内殿神龛前铺着的深红织锦草席
data.action: 侧卧在铺开红毡的和室榻榻米上，纯白巫女衣襟散敞，黑发马尾如墨铺散，单手轻抚微烫脸颊，紫眸流转着微醺般的情动笑意
data.lighting: 神前长明灯的柔和微光照耀肌肤
data.promptProse: Inside the quiet shrine inner room, Akeno reclines on her side along a crimson felt cloth laid across the tatami. Warm paper-lantern light softens the woven mats as she props her cheek on one hand and meets the viewer's gaze.
data.nsfwProse: Her ceremonial white miko kimono hangs unfastened and off her shoulders above the scarlet hakama, exposing her collarbones, bare shoulders, and deep cleavage.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side atop the crimson felt blanket on the shrine tatami, she rests one cheek in her hand with a warm flushed smile as her white miko robe slips loose off her shoulders.
